lead: The personal site and portfolio of Romit Raj Sahu, a guy striving to leave his mark on computer science.

ticker.note: The small words of the status ticker. The labels are read out by screen readers and are not shown. In 'weather', {temperature} and {condition} are filled in by the page; the words for the sky are in weather.json.

letter.label: A quick note before you scroll
paragraphs: hey there (yes, you, the one scrolling),
this is my corner on the internet, where I share my thoughts and show my work.
you may like some of it and dislike some of it, but you’re bound to learn something new.

about.heading: About the human
about.quote: Before forming an opinion of something or someone, understand them first.
paragraphs: I’m a CS student (the indecisive kind) currently based in California (oh, you wish) Bangalore, India. I’m into full stack, DevOps, servers, self-hosting and the open web.
I try to stay in the loop with the latest happenings in tech.

blocks.label: Availability
blocks.text: I’m open to internships and full-time roles. If you have something interesting, say hi.

blocks.label: Contact
blocks.text: Email is the fastest way to reach me: {email}. There is also a resume, if you want it.
